name: @equin/plugin-framework-cli-build-progress
description: The durable per-build progress log (build-progress.jsonl): the writer `./equin build` opens (run, span enter/leave, heartbeat, done — synchronous lines, so a wedged or killed build still names its phase) and readBuildProgress, which reconstructs each run with lastAdvanceAt, the last time it demonstrably moved. A leaf, so whoever judges a running build (its lock waiters, an install waiting on the build slot) can read it without the op machinery.
